title: Write the framework terminology
acceptance: Defines every capitalised or technical term used in the five core specs, one definition each, with source clause references.
Lists retired names with replacements: OS/7 to OS/10, Kernel Map to Release Manifest, operator map to the surface map (HTSM), amk-registry to amk-authority, host-ai-kernel-prompt to amk-prompt.
Disambiguates the three axes: platform profile (Basic/Standard/High capability tiers), kernel operating level (verified Host AI capability), conformance level (proof).
No term is defined twice; any contradiction found with an existing clause is listed under Findings, not silently resolved.
